- All 6 items done; typecheck + oxc clean

Verify independently.

1. Read all 6 changed files and verify each against the spec above.

3. `git show --stat 379be8b5` — only the 6 expected files, at HEAD, correct message.
4. `cd apps/mobile && bun run typecheck` — zero errors.
